scenario.profile: No real-user biography or inferred demographic/friend/dwell claims.

scope: Offline discovery/extraction comparison. No production DB, adapter, ranker or UI change; no paid provider or model call. Public links/derived diagnostic facts only.
hypotheses: Explicit source searches may find cafe-related events missed by general date/interest searches.
Structured Event metadata can verify dates and venues for temporary events without an indexed POI.
More detailed labels can distinguish a coffee activity from incidental coffee; profile-summary effectiveness remains a proposed separate ablation.
budget: Each query individually, retain first two distinct URLs in returned order. Dedupe pooled URLs, max12 selected. Read every selected page once; one ordinary public HTTP fallback on internal reader failure only, never bypass a denial. At most one original-event link per selected aggregator/calendar page. No target-name queries. No extra queries after results.
eligibility: Public event evidence for Sep26 or27 local time and identifiable NYC venue. Exclude cancelled, private-only, wrong city/day, routine opening-hours listings; uncertain remains unverified. All selected URLs receive disposition. Event summaries from calendar entries are distinct from confirmed primary listings.
scoring: Reuse v0 50 coffee-centered /40 cafe setting /10 participatory weights; evidence labels manual, no tuning. v1 adds diagnostic activity/setting/format/access fields but no new score weights.
success: Compare verified relevant new events per selected URL and incremental unique events. Disclose unequal query specificity: source arm searches month broadly, eligibility still exact two days. Small availability study, not recall or personal quality proof. Do not declare source-arm success if no incremental verified cafe event.
provenance: Sep20 previously seen events and owner-supplied Last Bite are development examples excluded from unseen yield, even if resurfaced. Known source leads were owner-suggested; not wholly unknown-source discovery.
followthrough: Save source/link dispositions, verified candidate facts, provisional score components and a score-hidden human review sheet. Rights to automate collection/storage must be separately established before ingestion.
